score_note: Continuation of 01251 FVF clipped point-fill native GPU windows; no new independent feature or score for bounds extension, CI repair, C6 or retest.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Source/build test only until an exact game menu, vehicle selection and race desktop launch provides observable native GPU pixels; native full-frame parity and Quest3 HMD currently UNTESTED.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native mode is opt-in; any CPU clip, GPU Map or source validation failure aborts native frame publication and keeps actual original D3D9 Draw, DX9Ex renderer, game input and FFB unchanged; DXVK frozen.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Real original FVF 1100-face user-clipped Draw expands to 6600 preserved point shader vertices, plans 6144+456 GPU upload windows retaining payload UVs and original ordering.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Malformed original index and source capacity fail closed; invalid GPU window preserves output args, and a failed later Map aborts native frame publication without altering the authoritative D3D9 draw.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 Draw -> game_fvf_clipped_point_vertices -> source envelope budget -> GPU WRITE_DISCARD windows -> D3D11 Draw with original OM/RT/depth; mandatory exact SHA gates in progress.

feature_contract.goal: Fully original-game FVF clipped point-fill triangles of any admitted triangle topology stream through native D3D11 point windows without arbitrary expansion truncation, extra GPU buffer allocation, or loss of source fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Source FVF clip to complete point fan expansion, bounded reusable GPU IA windows and ordered D3D11 Draws.
Any malformed IA, clipped source overrun or GPU write failure aborts partial native publication while original D3D9 Draw, input and FFB survive.
Fast, Backend, Win32 Build, OpenXR, HUD pass on one exact validation-bearing commit; no claim of actual game/HMD runtime.

runtime_validation_notes: Quest 3/VDXR and physical desktop game renderer not tested; RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED.
